item.description: A war of words has erupted between a popular preschool in Hong Kong and a parent who alleges that his two-year-old son suffered a large bump on his head on campus, though police closed their investigation after finding no CCTV evidence that the child had been hurt on site. item.title: Musk ordered to preserve records on Ukraine’s Starlink access by Democratic US senators
item.description: Democratic US senators have told Elon Musk to preserve all records related to his company SpaceX’s restrictions on Ukraine’s use of its Starlink and Starshield satellite services. Ukrainian forces say Starshield, the military-grade version of ‌Starlink, is vital for frontline communications and drone operations in their defence against Russian drone and missile attacks. item.title: Hong Kong travellers face 2 days of delays as US ground stop hits 17 city flights
item.description: Flights between the United States and Hong Kong will face continued disruptions over the next two days, the Airport Authority has warned, after a nationwide US ground stop forced the cancellation of nearly 10,000 flights and hit at least 17 services to and from the city. item.title: Hong Kong urged to look beyond university rankings to attract international students
item.description: Leaders of top British universities have urged the city to look beyond institutional rankings in its “Study in Hong Kong” campaign, warning that attracting and keeping top overseas talent requires government-backed career incentives and clear post-study visa pathways.
